plain_text:
Minutes for GNRLF Meeting 
11/16/26 – noon  
Room 208, Nashua City Hall 
 
 
Attending Committee Members: David Dearborn, Liz Hannum, Christine Malloy, Stephen Michon, Lyn Tripp. 
Administration: Abimana Ngira, Kathleen Palmer. Absent: Dawn Enwright. 
 
Call to Order: 12:05 pm. 
Approval of Minutes: for Oct. Motion to Approve was made by Christine, seconded by David, all in favor; 
approved. 
Adoption of Administrative Plan, Part II: Upon review of the draft, a Motion to Adopt and send the draft to 
the EDA for approval was made by Christine. Seconded by Liz, all in favor; Part II now joins Part I of being ready 
for EDA review. 
2026 year in review, 2027 work plan going forward: The committee discussed the accomplishments of the 
year, and determined what items remained on the to-do list. Brainstorming then turned to plans for next 
year’s goals and accomplishments. These brainstorming notes will be formatted into a draft of proposed goals 
and a 2027 work plan, by Stephen, Liz and Abimana. 
RLF portfolio update, to-do list: 
• Check on fraudulent CARES Act loans (Lyn to reach out to EDA). 
• Discover addresses for Bobo’s and Stone Social (Liz). 
• San Francisco Kitchen: Abimana to find time with Christine and David to review financials and come to 
Dec. meeting with a proposal to rework/refinance payments. 
• Rhum Bar: Liz to email owner to get his decision on which option he chooses for repayment. 
Other business: BDC sent a proposed application from RocketDrop. There were too many questions that arose 
from the committee’s initial reading of it to discuss at the end of this meeting. More info will be needed to aid 
evaluation. 
Meeting Adjourned at 1:40 pm.  
Next meeting: Noon Monday, Dec. 7, in Room 208.
